name: Ash Hardwood Floors in Kirkland: Refinishing and Staining Notes
title-tag: Ash Hardwood Floors in Kirkland: Refinish & Stain Guide
meta-description: Ash refinishes beautifully — as hard as oak, paler, and stain-friendly. A Kirkland contractor’s notes on sanding ash, finish chemistry, and stain colors.
post-summary: November 25, 2026 · Ash is the species homeowners mistake for oak — as hard as the oaks, paler, with bold straight grain. Our field notes on refinishing it in Kirkland homes: why waterborne finish is non-negotiable on ash, which stains flatter the grain, and the midcentury floors hiding under ambered oil poly near the lake.
